items.title: Steam Global Top Sellers — Windrose Holds Strong in Week 20
items.author: SteamDB
items.summary: Windrose remains on the Steam Global Top Sellers chart for Week 20 (May 5–12, 2026), continuing its strong momentum since Early Access launch.
items.content:
Windrose continues its impressive chart run, holding a spot on the Steam Global Top Sellers list for the week of May 5–12, 2026. This marks the fourth consecutive week the survival RPG has appeared on the chart since its Early Access debut on April 14.

What This Means for Players

A strong sales presence signals an active and growing player base, which is great news for the game's longevity and future development. With more players joining daily, expect more community-driven discoveries, build strategies, and bug reports that accelerate development.

Key Takeaways

  • Windrose has maintained Top Sellers status for 4 consecutive weeks
  • The growing player base means more community content and faster wiki data
  • Developer Kraken Express has additional resources to fund content updates
items.guide_impact: No direct guide changes needed. Indicates strong player interest and validates guide investment.

items.content:
Windrose appears on the Steam Global Top Sellers chart for the week of April 28 – May 5, 2026. This marks the third week in a row the pirate survival RPG has topped the charts.

Why It Matters

Sustained chart presence two weeks after launch shows genuine player demand rather than just launch-day hype. The game crossed 1.5 million copies sold during this period, a significant milestone for an indie Early Access title.

Guide Impact

With rapid player growth, expect increased demand for beginner guides, crafting recipes, and boss strategies. Our most-visited pages during this period were the Beginner Guide and Crafting Recipes.

items.name: Patch Notes, version: 0.10.0.5.120-073042fb
items.title: Patch Notes v0.10.0.5.120 — Steam Cloud Saves Fix & Stability Update
items.author: Bambino
items.summary: Kraken Express rolls out Patch v0.10.0.5.120 targeting Steam Cloud Save corruption and overall game stability improvements.
items.content:
Developer Kraken Express has released Patch v0.10.0.5.120 for Windrose, primarily addressing a critical issue with Steam Cloud Saves that was causing save corruption for some players.

What Changed

  • Steam Cloud Saves Fix — Resolved an issue where cloud saves could become corrupted during sync, potentially causing progress loss
  • Stability Improvements — General crash fixes and performance optimizations
  • Save System Hardening — Additional safeguards added to prevent future save-related issues

Guide Impact Analysis

This patch primarily affects the technical side of the game rather than gameplay mechanics. However, players who lost progress due to save corruption may need to revisit early-game content.

  • Server Guide: Dedicated server operators should update to this version. Check our Dedicated Server Guide for update instructions.
  • FAQ: We've updated our FAQ page with information about recovering from save corruption.
  • No recipe or balance changes — All crafting, resource, and boss data remains current.

Developer Note

Kraken Express stated they will be "closely monitoring feedback" after this update, suggesting further stability patches may follow quickly.
items.guide_impact: Update /server-guide with new version info. Update /faq with save corruption recovery steps.

items.name: New Windrose update fixes your holey roofs with more building pieces, and its performance foundations are now much sturdier
items.title: Ashlands Preview & Building Update — New Pieces, Better Performance
items.author: PCGamesN
items.summary: Kraken Express previews the upcoming Ashlands biome and delivers a building system update with new pieces and major performance improvements.
items.content:
Windrose has been out in open waters for just over two weeks, and developer Kraken Express has already charted a course towards its next major update. The upcoming Ashlands biome is the headline feature on the horizon, but in the meantime, players are getting immediate improvements to the building system and performance.

New Building Pieces

The update adds several new building components that address community feedback about roof construction gaps and limited architectural options:

  • New roof corner pieces that eliminate the notorious "holey roof" problem
  • Additional wall variants for more creative base designs
  • Improved snapping system for smoother building placement

Performance Improvements

The performance update focuses on the foundation systems that affect all aspects of gameplay:

  • Reduced frame drops in areas with many structures
  • Improved network synchronization for co-op building
  • Better memory management for extended play sessions

Ashlands Biome Preview

While the Ashlands biome is still at least 6 months away, Kraken Express has teased new environmental hazards, unique resources, and boss encounters that will come with the expansion. Players should focus on mastering current content and preparing strong gear sets.

Guide Impact Analysis

  • Building Guide: Our Building Guide needs updating with the new roof and wall pieces.
  • Beginner Guide: The improved building system makes base construction more accessible for new players.
  • Resource Planning: No new crafting materials added — existing resource guides remain accurate.
items.guide_impact: Update /building with new building pieces. Note Ashlands timeline in relevant pages.

items.name: New accolades trailer to celebrate over 1,500,000 copies sold!
items.title: Windrose Celebrates 1.5 Million Copies Sold — Accolades Trailer Released
items.author: Bambino
items.summary: Kraken Express celebrates 1.5 million copies sold in just two weeks with a new accolades trailer, thanking the community and hinting at future content.
items.content:
Ahoy, captains! Windrose has officially surpassed 1,500,000 copies sold in just two weeks since its Early Access launch on April 14, 2026. Developer Kraken Express marked the occasion with a special accolades / thank-you trailer celebrating the milestone.

By the Numbers

  • 1.5 million+ copies sold in 16 days
  • 150,000+ peak concurrent players
  • Steam Wishlist count exceeded 1.5 million before launch
  • Demo was downloaded over 850,000 times

What the Developers Said

In their announcement, Kraken Express expressed gratitude to the community: "That's a token of our appreciation to each and every one of you who believed in Windrose and set sail with us." They also hinted at exciting plans for the future of Windrose during its Early Access journey.

What This Means for the Game

Strong early sales give Kraken Express the resources to deliver on their roadmap, which includes:

  • The Ashlands biome — a major content expansion expected in 6+ months
  • Expansion from 4-player co-op to 8-player co-op
  • Approximately 50% more content planned for the full release
  • Continued bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements

Guide Impact

No direct gameplay changes, but the milestone confirms the game's longevity and validates investing time in comprehensive guides. Expect the player base to continue growing as positive word-of-mouth spreads.
items.guide_impact: No gameplay changes. Update homepage news section with milestone info.
